notes:
- **Overhauled Song Recommendations**: Rebuilt scoring with multi-seed consensus, artist-level taste & skip learning, YouTube Music Related tracks, and accurate vibe/region detection.
- **Smarter Autoplay & Radio**: Fixed the 2-song single-artist lock-in trap, prevented duplicate radio races, and switched Autoplay to multi-track session context with artist variety.
- **Accurate Listening Signals**: Stopped 0ms play-history pollution from skipped songs, fixed skip detection in Shuffle/Smart Shuffle, and synced likes and skips across Spotify and YouTube IDs.
- **Fresh Home Feed & Feedback Controls**: Added Pull-to-Refresh, cross-section deduplication, quick Not Interested controls in the player & queue, and Settings options to reset recommendations or re-pick artists.
